title: Progressive gate and fleet recovery reads
description: Uses source UI, a real authenticated private gateway, held transport replies and an isolated Git workspace. Never releases a slot or starts a worker. Requires an existing isolated Agent Chrome CDP endpoint.

proofTargets.claim: Stored acceptance and paused action controls render within two seconds while the current read is held.
The stored Package can be opened without an eager live source diff or a mutating RPC.
Withholding the stored response prevents package details from appearing until it is released.
The actual fleet dialog shows its saved eligible row before current inspection completes, with release paused.

gate.intent: Stored gate details render before the held current reply.

gate-observed.intent: Require completed browser assertions and owned teardown.

causal.intent: Withholding the real stored reply hides package details.

causal-observed.intent: Require completed browser assertions and owned teardown.

fleet.intent: Saved fleet rows stay visible while inspection is held.

fleet-observed.intent: Require completed browser assertions and owned teardown.
